The '''Imperial Special Tactical Forces''' was an elite designation of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]]. Imperial Special Forces had multiple units that fought against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Special forces members often used [[Berserker rifle/Legends|berserker rifles]].

==Description==
Independent from the regular [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]], the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]] was an elite [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] division which developed its own special forces contingent of [[Storm commando/Legends|storm commandos]]. The [[Imperial Commando Special Unit]] were additionally part of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] personal [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]].

The Imperial Army nevertheless had multiple special forces units formed of [[Imperial Army trooper/Legends|Imperial Army troopers]] and [[land assault trooper]]s, such as the [[Imperial Hammers Elite Armor Unit/Legends|Imperial Hammers Elite Armor Unit]], which was designated the 112th Repulsorlift Armor Regiment and commonly known as the "Hell's Hammers." [[High Colonel/Legends|High Colonel]] [[Zel Johans]]'s tank unit continued its distinguished service largely using [[Hovertank/Legends|repulsortanks]] of the [[Imperial-class repulsortank|''Imperial''-class]] despite the rising popularity of [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]] developed by the [[Imperial Department of Military Research/Legends|Imperial Department of Military Research]].<ref name="J15">{{JournalCite|15|Special Military Unit Intelligence Update}}</ref> Members of the Imperial Army's [[Lightning Battalion]] were special forces personnel who wore nonstandard blue uniforms during their [[Icarii Campaign|campaign]] to wipe out the [[Icarii]] people.

Most [[Imperial officer/Legends|officers]] of the army's [[Ghost Battalion]] special forces were graduates of the [[Carida Academy/Legends|Academy of Carida]], though [[First Lieutenant/Legends|First Lieutenant]] [[Brazack]] of the [[Battalion/Legends|battalion's]] Second Platoon B Company was an enlisted soldier who earned a field promotion. When [[High Inquisitor]] [[Jerec (Inquisitor)|Jerec]] and his [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial Star Destroyer]], the [[Vengeance (Imperial-class, Jerec)|''Vengeance'']], [[Subjugation of Sulon|subjugated]] [[Sulon]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] commanded the ''Vengeance'' while [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Noda]] led Imperial Army forces, with First Lieutenant Brazack leading the Special Ops Group.<ref name="Dark Solider" /> The [[Imperial Officer Corps/Legends|Imperial Officer Corps]] also selected [[Imperial commando/Legends|Imperial commandos]] from among its members.

The [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Starfleet]] had its own [[Imperial Naval Special Forces|naval special forces]] branch formed of SpecNav troopers, including the [[Venom Guard]] who were requested by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Sakai]] to help counter the rebel [[Reekeene's Roughnecks]]. Moreover, [[Imperial Navy commando]]s dressed in modified stormtrooper armor and served as elite sentinels aboard Star Destroyers. The naval [[Starfighter Corps (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Starfighter Corps]] had various elite pilot units, such as the [[Scimitar assault wing]] and Darth Vader's [[Black Eight Squadron]].

[[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] ideological agency, the [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|Commission for the Preservation of the New Order]] (COMPNOR), had its own loyal [[CompForce/Legends|CompForce]] embedded throghout the Imperial Military. The [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] further deployed highly trained [[tactical unit]]s of ISB combat agents joined by ISB stormtroopers who were selected via COMPNOR, ambiguously working outside the Imperial Military's authority. Darth Vader personally used the services of the [[Noghri Death Commando]]s, who later served [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] Thrawn following the Empire's [[Battle of Endor/Legends|collapse]] until their [[Noghri revolution|revolution]] with the help of [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]].

==History==
After receiving direct orders from the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] himself, Imperial Special Forces established a head hunter squadron on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] with the aim of destroying a secret [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] base nearby [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] which culminated in the [[Battle of Talus]].

Before coming an [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]], [[Lumiya|Shira Brie]] served with Special Forces.

[[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Davod Jon]] was in command of a special forces unit prior to the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

Darth Vader promised that he would save the [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]] people's [[Honoghr/Legends|poisoned homeworld]], and their warriors served the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] as [[Noghri Death Commando]]s in the Empire. Vader later handed Grand Admiral Thrawn command of the Death Commandos, who served as part of [[Thrawn's confederation|Thrawn's forces]] following the Empire's collapse. After [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] Leia Organa of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] helped the Noghri realize that the Empire had been keeping their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] poisoned, the Noghri commandos turned against Thrawn and a number of Noghri defended Princess Organa and her [[Skywalker family/Legends|family]] through the times of the New Republic and the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]].
